title: [SOA] Keep email attachments next to the current message
summary: The Attachments part on the SOA Email Message page moved directly below the Message, before Previous Messages, to visually group current message content with its attachments.
key_points: Reordered page controls to place Attachments immediately after Message instead of after Previous Messages
Improves usability by keeping current message and attachments together visually
No changes to captions, visibility, attachment behavior, or sending logic
Low-risk layout-only change with no schema or permission impacts
Affects both incoming and outgoing messages in Sales Order Agent
quote: Move the existing Attachments part immediately below Message and before Previous Messages on page 4404
